{"id":"persona-jl4j.2","title":"Return the silent-provable set, sorted and tagged","description":"Second half of the epic's surface 2. Once persona-5s4b.87 honours req.spiffe_id and the hint encoding exists, FetchJWTSVID returns every identity provable WITHOUT prompting a human, sorted best-first, each entry tagged via hint.

Two constraints from the epic decision, neither optional:

(1) Only silently-provable identities go in the list. An attestor that would prompt is not enumerated here -- it is reached by asking (hire_min_assurance, persona-ouo5.3) and costs exactly one touch. Today that distinction is free because neither prover prompts, which means it must be encoded as a property of the attestor NOW, while nothing depends on it, rather than discovered later when a FIDO2 tap regresses it.

(2) The sort order is documented but ADVISORY; hint is normative. svids[0] must be a defensible cheap answer, but no caller may be required to sort-order to be correct.","acceptance_criteria":"A consumer with two provable identities receives both; the order is documented; each entry carries a non-empty hint; an attestor marked as prompting never appears in the unconstrained response.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-15T20:21:43.793842059Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-09-15T20:21:43.793842059Z","labels":["api","spiffe","architecture"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"persona-jl4j.2","depends_on_id":"persona-jl4j","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-09-15T20:21:43.812014298Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"persona-jl4j.2","depends_on_id":"persona-jl4j.1","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-09-15T20:22:37.621939679Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"persona-jl4j.2","depends_on_id":"persona-jl4j.3","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-09-15T20:22:37.684594887Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"persona-jl4j.2","depends_on_id":"persona-5s4b.87","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-09-15T20:22:37.745567787Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}

{"notes":"CONSEQUENCE OF THE PROOF-COST DECLARATIONS, recorded 2026-09-15 when persona-jl4j.3 landed. Read this before implementing the filter.

Mark ruled ssh-agent INTERACTIVE. A key added with 'ssh-add -c' prompts on every
signature and the agent's identities answer does not carry that constraint, so
nothing can distinguish a confirm-flagged key from a plain one. Silent is a
guarantee; ssh cannot give it. gpg is Interactive for the same reason (pinentry
for an uncached key).

WHAT THAT MEANS FOR THIS BEAD, stated plainly so it is not discovered as a
regression: the Silent sources are did:key, oidc, tailscale and unix-account,
and of those ONLY UNIX-ACCOUNT CAN ACTUALLY PROVE TODAY. The other three
inherit the default prove() refusal (persona-qbnm). So the moment this filter
lands, an unconstrained FetchJWTSVID returns exactly one identity: the Unix
account, iaa1, no presence.

That is correct rather than broken, and it is the design working. ssh-agent is
still reachable -- a consumer that wants it asks for it, which costs at most one
prompt and usually zero, since most keys are not confirm-flagged. That is the
escalation path persona-jl4j decided on, exercised for the first time.

But do not land this filter and the driver work far apart. Until persona-qbnm.1
and .2 give did:key and gpg a real prove(), the unprompted path is a single
source, and the daemon will look like it regressed to whoever is not reading
this note."}
